sections.heading: C - Vehicle Equipment Section 15
sections.markdown:
## C - Vehicle Equipment Section 15

Pedagogic emphasis: lighting and brake numbers are highest yield [A01].

FACT_ID: sec15-F01 | anchor: A01
Assist features only help the driver and never replace driver control [A01].
Why it matters: exam trap.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0100]

FACT_ID: sec15-F02 | anchor: A01
Parking assist and cruise control are barred during the skills test [A01].
Why it matters: exam trap.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0100]

FACT_ID: sec15-F03 | anchor: A01
Every motor vehicle needs working brakes on all wheels meeting federal standards [A01].
Why it matters: exam trap.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0100]

FACT_ID: sec15-F04 | anchor: A01
A truck or tractor with three or more axles may omit brakes on front wheels [A01].
Why it matters: exam trap.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0100]

FACT_ID: sec15-F05 | anchor: A01
With ABS hold steady firm pressure and do not pump the pedal [A01].
Why it matters: exam trap.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0100]

FACT_ID: sec15-F06 | anchor: A02
Wide buses, RVs and trailers 80 inches or more need amber and red clearance lights [A02].
Why it matters: exam trap.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0101]

FACT_ID: sec15-F07 | anchor: A02
A load overhanging 4 feet needs two rear flags by day and lights by night [A02].
Why it matters: exam trap.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0101]

FACT_ID: sec15-F08 | anchor: A02
Emergency flares must be seen at 600 feet and burn 12 hours [A02].
Why it matters: exam trap.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0101]

FACT_ID: sec15-F09 | anchor: A02
Two white headlights must reach 350 feet high and 100 feet low [A02].
Why it matters: exam trap.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0101]

FACT_ID: sec15-F10 | anchor: A02
A horn must be heard from 200 feet under normal conditions [A02].
Why it matters: exam trap.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0101]

FACT_ID: sec15-F11 | anchor: A02
A white plate light must make the number readable from 50 feet [A02].
Why it matters: exam trap.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0101]

FACT_ID: sec15-F12 | anchor: A03
Two red tail and stop lights must be visible from 500 feet [A03].
Why it matters: exam trap.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0102]

FACT_ID: sec15-F13 | anchor: A03
Turn signals must be visible from 100 feet in normal sunlight [A03].
Why it matters: exam trap.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0102]

FACT_ID: sec15-F14 | anchor: A03
Reflectors must sit 15 to 60 inches high and be seen from 500 feet [A03].
Why it matters: exam trap.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0102]

FACT_ID: sec15-F15 | anchor: A03
The windshield must stay clear and wipers must clear moisture [A03].
Why it matters: exam trap.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0102]

High-yield ranked: headlight distances, horn distance, reflector rules.
Misconceptions: assist drives; ABS pumping; one tail light suffices.
Mnemonic: 350 high 100 low beam.
Glossary: ADAS assist; clearance light; reflector; parking brake.
